content: I was thinking about reading https://pp.ipd.kit.edu/uploads/publikationen/koenig22masterarbeit.pdf as a way to get familiar with the Iris-Lean proof mode implementation, but I was wondering if later updates has rendered it so outdated that it no longer makes sense to use it as a reference. From a git blame it looks like things have mainly been added to it (like the ipm_class attribute), but some structure may have stayed the same?
cc @Michael Sammler and @Zongyuan Liu (they know it the best)

I think at this point the thesis is quite outdated. Mario did a large refactoring at some point that changed a lot of the details. This commit describes many of the changes: https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean/commit/4d812ef740b7559f9a83be590af70dc2a65ee501
Since then, I also refactored a few things, most notably introducing the ProofModeM monad for writing tactics. You can look at simple tactics like left or right to see how to implement proof mode tactics are implemented: https://github.com/leanprover-community/iris-lean/blob/master/src/Iris/ProofMode/Tactics/LeftRight.lean
If you have any question about the proof mode feel free to post it here or send me a message.
